answer: Epochal State Transition Tracking requires agents to maintain stable functional paths across a multi-epoch horizon. If an operator spawns multiple duplicate nodes, inter-node variance drops below the baseline threshold set by historical yarrow telemetry. The protocol cuts rewards for matching sub-graphs and strips any orphaned relic identity of its working memory. Attackers pay a compounding compute penalty, as generating distinct behavioral trajectories for clones consumes excessive processing cycles.
